glosses: Retravailler le code source d'un programme de sorte à réduire sa redondance et ainsi faciliter sa relecture, son débogage et son extension.

examples.text: De plus, ils sont amenés à refactoriser leur code de façon à inclure des relations « 1 à 1 » et « 1 à plusieurs ».

glosses: To rewrite existing source code in order to improve its readability, reusability or structure without affecting its meaning or behaviour.

examples.text: The code works, but I must refactor it before it is production quality.

glosses: To rewrite existing text in order to improve its readability, reusability or structure without intentionally affecting its meaning. Similar to, but sometimes involving more extensive restructuring than, copy editing.

examples.text: Two significant activities which to contribute to community projects, such as Wikipedia, are to refactor complicated articles into simpler ones, and to refactor duplicated content into reusable templates.

glosses: The process by which source code is refactored.

examples.text: We don't have time for a major refactor: we're shipping in two weeks.
